body.text: Would you? Or would you write?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: I would prefer to write. Then you have a record of it.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: And if I were you, I would keep a copy of everything.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: With hindsight, I should have done that from the start.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Hindsight is always easy. Write the letter tonight.
